rows.en: They're the metal cells that make up the Devil Gundam's body!
Infected with DG Cells, these guys revive again and again, and their bodies keep getting stronger!!
That's right, the Devil Gundam!! Soon that ultimate power will be ours!!
Enough idle chatter! Hurry up and finish them off!!
Got it. Let's go, you lot!!
Damn you... Beaten yet again... B-but our revival technology doesn't end here...
Our research has advanced even further... ...Next time, you lot... will die!!
...Quick to run away as ever, damn her!!
God Gundam carefully examined the remains of the revived kaijin.
...Can the enemy already control DG Cells!?
...Their research has advanced? ...Did she mean the DG Cells?
...Their research has advanced? Did she mean the DG Cells?
...Their research has advanced? Did she mean the DG Cells?
...Their research has advanced? Did she mean the DG Cells?
She said their research has advanced... Do you think she meant the DG Cells?
Their research has advanced? ...Did she mean the DG Cells?
Their research has advanced, she says!? Oh, she means that DG-whatsit stuff?
...Their research has advanced? ...Did she mean the DG Cells?
...Their research has advanced? ...Did she mean the DG Cells?
...Their research has advanced? ...Did she mean the DG Cells?
Yeah... Things have gotten pretty bad...
Fufufufufu... The power of the DG Cells is tremendous.
It was worth having them brought all the way from that one's Cube!
Damn right!! Ain't it the best!? Kyoeeeeeeh!!
Indeed. They allow for truly fascinating experiments.
My Choju, infected with DG Cells... What sort of fight will they show me...
It's a blast, ain't it!! Mixin' DG Cells into kaijin and kaiju!!
Things are gettin' downright insane now!!!
Oho, and here come just the right opponents!!
Huh? Screw that! Who said anything about fighting you lot!?
Like hell you are!! I'm gonna crush you!! Me, the great Gundam Heaven's Sword!!
Fuhahahaha!! Well now, you've got nowhere left to run, have you?
Now, Heaven's Sword, and my Choju!! Use the power of the DG Cells to destroy those heroes!!
Hmm... The fusion with the Choju is still incomplete...
But Heaven's Sword is impressive. Truly worthy of one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings.
Heaven's Sword's wounds had already been repaired by the DG Cells.
I don't die that easy, y'know!? C'mon!! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!!

notes.note: Zanjioh answering Bee Woman's order in story_051 #0.100. Shocker kaijin cry 'Igii' rendered 'Igiiiiiiih!!' (no earlier English precedent found).

#0.103-0.104 unlabelled; read as the villains (Zanjioh/Bee Woman) boasting about the DG Cells, but the wording also works if God Gundam explains. 'DG Cells' (Devil Gundam Cells) is the standard G Gundam term; not in glossary.
Masculine 'ore-tachi' and the reply to the hero's question: Zanjioh. #0.108 feminine imperative = Bee Woman; #0.109 = Zanjioh.
Shocker death cry 'Shocker banzai' rendered 'Long live Shocker'; 'munen da' = 'I've failed'.
Unlabelled; likely Rider 2 (who knows Bee Woman from before). 'yatsu-me' about Bee Woman (g=f) -> 'damn her'.
#0.122-0.127 unlabelled; the narration #0.125 places God Gundam examining the bodies, so #0.126-0.127 are probably God Gundam. Left unattributed in English.

#0.128-0.137 are ten party-leader variants echoing Bee Woman's 'our research has advanced' (#0.116), hence 'she'. Identical Japanese kept identical; the only differences are ellipsis placement. #0.132 soft 'kana' (polite leader); #0.134 rough (Momotaros-type) calls them 'DG-whatsit'.
Unlabelled reply to the leader; probably God Gundam. Subject restored as 'Things'.
'Yatsu no Cube': owner unnamed (probably the Devil Gundam side / Master Asia, cf. 0326 #0.79 in story_053); kept gender-neutral as 'that one's Cube'. Object (the DG Cells) restored as 'them'.
Heaven's Sword (Michelo) voiced crude and manic; 'kaijin ya kaiju' kept as 'kaijin and kaiju' (Rider monsters and Ultra monsters).
Ankh refusing Yapool's challenge; #0.21 'Oi' is to the party.
#0.32-0.41 leader variants; 'yatta ze' (#0.33) rougher -> 'Yeah, we did it!!'; punctuation follows each variant.
'Devil Gundam Shitennou' rendered 'the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings' (G Gundam English usage); not in glossary.

report: 80/80 rows. Unlabelled speakers inferred: 0325 #0.103-0.104 (villains, could be God Gundam), #0.121 (Rider 2), #0.123-0.127/#0.138 (God Gundam likely). 0326 #0.2 'that one's Cube' owner unknown, kept neutral. Not in glossary: DG Cells, Four Heavenly Kings (Devil Gundam Shitennou).
